entities.name: Eugene John Gerber

entities.summary: Eugene John Gerber was an American prelate of the Catholic Church. He served as bishop of the Diocese of Dodge City in Kansas from 1976 to 1982, and bishop of the Diocese of Wichita in Kansas from 1982 to 2001.
